turns.question: At which hour of the day were the most page views recorded between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many page views were in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hour-of-day breakdown (its time grains are day, week, month and year), so I cannot name the busiest hour; the closest figure is 10 page views (customer actions filtered to page_view) between 20 September and 3 October 2026, with the busiest day being 1 October at 5. Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
